messages:
incident-bot: PAGED alice_oncall: Suspicious egress from log-collector -> external storage. 4xx->5xx spikes on auth-proxy, 03:04 UTC. auto-tag:security,priority:high

alice_oncall: ack. bringing SRE + security. pulling runbook now.

dave_sre: on it. can someone confirm which cluster? I see collector-3 in us-west-2 showing large PUTs to s3://ext-collector-archive

liam_engineer: that's the new telemetry pipeline we rolled yesterday. pipeline uses svc-acct `telemetry-writer@redwood-prod`.

megan_sec: tagging possible data exposure. MEGAN_SEC here — need scope: are these internal debug logs or customer payloads?

liam_engineer: sampling one object now — looks like lines with session headers + bearer snippets. not full tokens but fragments.

alice_oncall: ok assume sensitive. Priority: rotate svc-acct keys, block outbound to that bucket, preserve evidence. 

alice_oncall: action items: 1) dave -> isolate collector pod / cordon node 2) liam -> revoke svc-acct keys + create new ones 3) megan -> legal/customer-ops notify plan 4) tom -> draft customer comm if needed

megan_sec: I need preserved artifacts. do NOT delete the S3 objects. we'll snapshot and copy to internal secure bucket for forensics.

dave_sre: isolating node now: `kubectl drain collector-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` 

dave_sre: applied network policy to block external s3 endpoint from pod subnet (egress deny) — confirm egress is blocked.

deploy-bot: deploy status: network-policy-update -> success (green) in 2m35s

liam_engineer: revoking keys now. running aws iam list-access-keys for telemetry-writer. creating new key pair, updating creds in secrets manager.

liam_engineer: created new keys and rotated in SecretsManager; updated deployment env, will restart pods on rolling restart.

alice_oncall: megan_sec, rachel_legal, tom_custops — who owns external comms? we need decision: customer notification now or wait for forensics summary.

rachel_legal: rachel_legal here. we need timeline + scope before notifying customers. legal prefers statement within 6 hours if customer data is confirmed. preserve chain-of-custody.

megan_sec: I'll run quick grep on sampled objects for PII markers and token patterns. ETA 30m. will update with confidence level.

tom_custops: prepping a holding message for customers: short note that we're investigating a telemetry pipeline incident, no evidence of broad compromise so far. hold until megan gives go.

alice_oncall: update: pods restarted with new creds, egress blocked, keys rotated, artifacts copied to `s3://sec-evidence/3334445555/` (read-only). Forensics to megan_sec.

megan_sec: initial check: several objects contained auth header fragments and user identifiers. no full access tokens seen in samples. marking as "suspected exposure". continuing deeper scan.

liam_engineer: we also found a misconfigured forwarder in the pipeline that allowed staging bucket writes to the external bucket. patching config to enforce allowed-destinations.

alice_oncall: good catch. can we get a commit/PR link?

liam_engineer: PR: https://git.internal/r/telemetry/patches/245 — config fix + stricter validation.

megan_sec: escalation: recommend immediate key rotation for any historical keys that had write permission to that external bucket. I'll enumerate list and share next.

alice_oncall: rachel_legal, do we need to engage law enforcement?

rachel_legal: not at this time. continue containment and evidence collection. notify if we confirm exfil of customer-sensitive credentials.

tom_custops: drafting customer advisory. will hold send until megan_sec gives classification.

megan_sec: classification update (30m): exposure = low-medium. fragments of auth headers and user IDs present but no active full tokens. recommend customer notification with guidance to rotate any long-lived keys and monitor for suspicious access.

alice_oncall: decision: proceed with customer advisory within 3 hours, include mitigation steps. megan_sec -> prepare brief. tom_custops -> prepare message. rachel_legal -> approve content. liam_engineer/dave_sre -> sweep config and rotated keys list.

liam_engineer: done: list of rotated keys attached to secure ticket #SEC-2026-118.

dave_sre: node collector-3 reintroduced with patched config, rolling restart completed. monitoring for anomalies.

deploy-bot: canary metrics: no error spike after restart for 15m.

alice_oncall: closing loop: evidence preserved, keys rotated, egress blocked, customer comm approved pending legal review. logging this incident and creating postmortem owner. postmortem owner: megan_sec.

megan_sec: will own postmortem and notify affected customers per legal guidance.

alice_oncall: thanks team. will update incident ticket with timeline and actions. :white_check_mark:
